observations: Grey islands clearly show plausible cool fractured mineral faces and pits; this is a recognisable component, not whole-source qualification.
Brown ridges are less smoothly fibrous than the original parent, with more angular chips, shallow pits and broken surfaces. This is an actual improvement.

The brown surface does not unequivocally read as compact matte earth/weathered mineral matrix with bound aggregate and quiet areas. Its repeated curled surface cues can read as dry vegetal debris on rootlike ridges; the requested material gate is unresolved.
